material_updates.topic: HUST published official international undergraduate admissions guide for 2027 on 2026-10-26

details.application_fee_direct: CNY 800 non-refundable; English text says due by 2027-02-25; Chinese text says within 15 days of submission. University clarification required.
details.ielts: IELTS >=5.5; TOEFL >=80; Duolingo >=110; English-medium previous schooling may be exempt
details.csca: Mathematics + Chemistry for English MBBS; score report listed in academic documents
details.sat_unt: SAT and Kazakhstan UNT/MЭСК not listed as mandatory in this guide
details.documents: Expected graduation certificate accepted for current seniors; transcripts; personal statement; self-introduction video <=60 sec; English evidence; CSCA; passport valid beyond 2028-10-15; medical examination; noncriminal certificate; bank statement/financial guarantee >=USD 5000 for regular admissions; China guardian authorization and guarantee letter if under 18 on 2027-09-01
details.scholarship: CSC Type A is a separate no-application-fee route through Kazakhstan dispatching authority; whether HUST English MBBS is covered and whether full expenses are funded remains unconfirmed

material_updates.topic: Nanjing Medical University 2026 FAQ establishes CSC exclusion and conflicts with guide on fees
material_updates.details: Official 2026 FAQ explicitly says MBBS is not covered by CSC Type A or Type B, says no application fee; official 2026 MBBS guide lists CNY 500 registration fee. The CNY 13,000 non-refundable deposit is required even if tuition scholarship is awarded. Do not assume 2027 identical; seek clarification.

material_updates.topic: Kazakhstan Center for International Programs intergovernmental scholarship general eligibility and documents
material_updates.details: Current official instructions state bachelor's GPA threshold >=4.00/5.00, English-language study IELTS >=5.5 or TOEFL >=46 or proof of prior English-medium education, and notarized legal guardian consent for applicants under 18. This is general intergovernmental eligibility, not confirmation of a 2027/28 China English MBBS award.
